lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 2, enlarged with Pillow: two marks inside the shank. The right mark is a long flat lozenge, the shape French maker's marks take, worn blank. Photo 1, enlarged: rose-yellow gold scroll head with coiled wire, two grey domed caps that look tarnished (silver or white metal, not gold), empty centre setting, thin shank. No stones visible.
